description: A wrapper over the git CLI for the HopeLab apps: porcelain v2 status, worktree list/add/remove, merge preview, commit graph layout, fetch/pull/rebase, and a per-repository write lock.
The update view model the HopeLab desktop apps share (ReactiveUI, no UI framework): check timer, banner, tray text, Settings status and GitHub-token handling. Each app keeps its own themed views.
Updates for apps released on GitHub: latest.json manifests, version checks, private-repository tokens, verified downloads, in-place file swaps with rollback, and Debian-package installs.
Small building blocks shared by the HopeLab apps: Result<T> and Unit, a clock abstraction, and atomic file writes.

Contracts for the Manifest client: the IManifestClient abstraction, request and response records, the object-set filter builder and the client's errors. Reading the ontology and its data, and invoking actions, through Manifest's governed REST surface. Manifest.Client.Http implements it.

The System.Net implementation of the Manifest client (Manifest.Client.Core): HttpClientFactory registration, Authlink bearer authentication, and Manifest's ProblemDetails translated to ErrorOr errors.
